title: Guardian consent never gates Coursera activation; courseraConsentGate.ts is absent
blast: An under-18 CHS signup can be admin-approved and then self-enroll into Coursera with no recorded parent/guardian consent. Seat spend, FERPA/COPPA exposure, and the school’s “consent before training is activated” promise all fail together.
evidence: ls lib/admin/courseraConsentGate.ts → No such file. rg ParentalConsentForm -g '*.ts' -g '*.tsx' → only components/forms/ParentalConsentForm.tsx:21 (export, no importers). rg guardianConsent|parentalConsent|courseraConsentGate on app/api/member/coursera, app/api/admin/coursera, lib/admin/courseraEnrollmentApproval.ts, app/api/apply/signup/route.ts → no matches. lib/admin/courseraEnrollmentApproval.ts:39-46 flips courseraEnrollmentApproved with no consent read. app/api/member/coursera/enroll-in-course/route.ts:95-106 gates only on courseraEnrollmentApproved. lib/nav/ageBasedNav.ts:72 returns requiresParentalConsent but has no callers. marketing/src/pages/enroll/concordia.astro:74-75 promises school-collected consent before activation.
verify: test -f lib/admin/courseraConsentGate.ts && rg -n "courseraApprovalBlockedByConsent|guardianConsent|parentalConsentGiven" app/api/member/coursera app/api/admin/coursera lib/admin/courseraEnrollmentApproval.ts

title: Admin partner pages load member emails and salaries with no tenant scope
blast: Any isAdmin() user (not isAdminInOrg) who opens /admin/partners/<uuid> reads that partner’s referred-member emails, placement salaries, and counselor emails even when the partner belongs to another org. The list page also dumps contactEmail/contactPhone/notes for every partner row. API routes under /api/admin/partners were scoped; the pages bypass that gate.
evidence: rg -n "withTenantScope|getActorOrganizationId" app/admin/partners --glob '*.tsx' → no matches. rg -n "getUser|isAdmin|withTenantScope|organizationId" app/admin/partners/[id]/page.tsx → no matches. app/admin/partners/[id]/page.tsx:46-93 prisma.partner.findUnique({ where: { id } }) includes member.email, salaryOffered, counselor user.email. app/admin/partners/page.tsx:30-51 prisma.partner.findMany select contactEmail, contactPhone, notes with no org filter. app/admin/partners/[id]/quarterly-outcomes/page.tsx:30-32 unscoped findUnique. lib/auth/roles.ts:40-52 isAdmin() is global; comment states it does not verify org. app/admin/layout.tsx:35 gates on isAdmin, not isAdminInOrg.

title: wap_partner_ref clear omits httpOnly/SameSite/Secure used when planting
blast: If the browser keeps the original 30-day httpOnly cookie because Set-Cookie attributes do not match, the next applicant on a shared school/library device inherits partner attribution, funding stamp, schoolName/schoolDistrict, and partner-portal PII visibility.
evidence: middleware.ts:250-256 plants wap_partner_ref with httpOnly:true, sameSite:'lax', secure in production, path:'/', maxAge 30d. app/api/apply/signup/route.ts:672 clears with cookieStore.set(PARTNER_REF_COOKIE, '', { maxAge: 0, path: '/' }) only. app/api/apply/signup/route.ts:662-669 comments that school computer labs are the normal case and that a leftover cookie mis-attributes applicants #2..N. app/api/apply/signup/route.test.ts:654-657 pins the incomplete clear options ({ maxAge: 0, path: '/' }).
